description: This file defines interfaces and functions for rate-limited work queues in Kubernetes, including types for rate limiting, configuration, and queue creation functions.

classes.name: rateLimitingType
classes.description: A struct implementing rate-limited re-enqueuing for a work queue, wrapping a delaying interface and a rate limiter.

methods.name: AddRateLimited
methods.description: Adds an item to the queue after the rate limiter permits.

methods.name: NumRequeues
methods.description: Returns the number of times an item has been requeued.

methods.name: Forget
methods.description: Stops tracking the item in the rate limiter.
